title: Compare dispatch-envelope roots by identity, not by spelling
action: The Windows job has been red since 2.1.9. envelope_and_prompt_name_the_granted_worktree_for_the_cells_feature compared the dispatch envelope's roots (git's writing of the path, long form) against the fixture's tempdir() paths (8.3 short form on a Windows runner): runneradmin vs RUNNER~1. Canonicalize both sides before comparing, and assert the prompt against the envelope's own spelling rather than the fixture's. Same rule and same reason as roots.rs's test-local norm.

truths: The assertion still proves the envelope names the granted worktree and the main store, not merely that two strings match

verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml; the Windows job must go green.

trace.outcome: Canonicalized both sides of the envelope root comparison and re-anchored the prompt assertions on the envelope's own spelling.
